descriptionChirho: To show forth or demonstrate a quality or attitude, whether God demonstrating wrath/mercy (Rom 9:17, 9:22; Eph 2:7; 1 Tim 1:16) or people displaying faithfulness/good conduct (2 Cor 8:24; Tit 2:10, 3:2; Heb 6:10-11; Rom 2:15; 2 Tim 4:14); all inflectional variants share this single meaning.
